targets.rawSql: SELECT manager, SUM(turnover) AS budget FROM dm.agency_finance WHERE report_month BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$manager' = '$__all' OR manager = ANY(string_to_array('$manager', ','))) GROUP BY manager ORDER BY budget DESC

SELECT platform, ROUND(AVG(avg_ctr),4) AS avg_ctr, ROUND(AVG(avg_cpc),2) AS avg_cpc, SUM(total_clicks) AS clicks FROM dm.platform_stats WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$platform' = '$__all' OR platform = ANY(string_to_array('$platform', ','))) GROUP BY platform ORDER BY clicks DESC

SELECT report_month AS time, industry, SUM(total_spend) AS spend FROM dm.client_kpi WHERE report_month BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$industry' = '$__all' OR industry = ANY(string_to_array('$industry', ','))) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT report_month, client_name, industry, total_spend, total_conversions, cpl FROM dm.client_kpi WHERE report_month BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date AND ('$industry' = '$__all' OR industry = ANY(string_to_array('$industry', ','))) ORDER BY total_spend DESC
